question: Oda-sensei!! Greetings. During the move "Kirisame", Hody's back fin transformed into a sharp edge. Are the back fins of fish-men detachable? Are they trade-able? Or did he just stab the weapon fin onto his back next to his real fin?? Please tell me!!
answer: That, my friend, is a weapon that you can slide onto the fin. (Translator's Note - Captions: *Top left: Damned human!! *Bottom Left: ← there is a hole. *Top center: Die damned human!! *Bottom right: ↑ mad at human. *Top right: Fit!!)
name: Meow
